global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with crisp menma and green scallions. Served in a white bowl with gold trim, it rests on a dark wood table under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Dark reddish-brown wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle sheen.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with gold trim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape, slightly raised rim with decorative gold lines.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and bean sprouts, showing rich brown color and bubbling surface texture.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale beige, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular, curved shapes.
